selection: All seven bootstrap roots after 101. Root 101 remains in the original experiment only.
endpoint: Inherit the original study's two paired contrasts, two primary noise bins and two phases with no arm or window changes.
world_seed_policy: Both donor and recipient roots are fresh for every bootstrap checkpoint; within each checkpoint they are held fixed across arms.
uncertainty: Paired hierarchical percentile bootstrap. Resample birth roots, donors within each root, and fresh private complement pairs within each donor.
